current_prompt.body:
READ the set S = {3, 34, 7, 12, 5, 26, 11, 8, 15, 2, 19, 21}
READ the target T = 40
USE a backtracking algorithm to explore the full search tree for subsets of S
FOR each subset that sums exactly to T
    EMIT the subset
    VERIFY that the subset sum equals T
END FOR
COUNT the total number of solutions
REPORT the total number of solutions

current_plan.body:
READ the set S and the target T
INITIATE backtracking search over subsets of S
FOR EACH subset generated BY backtracking
    IF the subset sum EQUALS T
        EMIT the subset
        VERIFY the subset sum equals T
    ENDIF
ENDFOR
COUNT the total number of emitted subsets
REPORT the total number of solutions
